setup.title: Welcome to Kometio
setup.description: This installation has not been set up yet. Create your administrator account to get started.
setup.tokenHint: Printed in the API's log when it starts. With Docker: `docker logs kometio` for the one-image install, `docker compose logs api` for the compose stack. It proves you are the person running this server, so nobody else can claim the installation before you.

setup.localeHint: The language your site's content starts in. You can add more later, in Site settings.
setup.domainHint: The address of your site as visitors type it: no http:// and no path (for example www.yoursite.com). We filled in the one this installation was set up for; change it if the site will live somewhere else, or empty it to set it later in Settings. Until a site has one, its address answers “not found”.
setup.passwordHint: At least {{count}} characters. This is the account nobody can unlock for you, so make it a good one.
setup.genericError: Something went wrong. Reload the page and try again — if this installation was already set up, you'll be sent to the login page.

import.choose: I already have a site from another installation
import.title: Open a site from another installation
import.description: Bring the site you exported from another Kometio: its pages, accounts and files come with it, so there is no account to create here.
import.fileHint: The .tar.gz file made by Settings → Export, or by `export` on the command line. It is read on this server and never leaves it.
import.back: Set up a new site instead

import.notFinished: The site could not be opened, and the server did not say why. Its log (`docker logs kometio`) has the reason; the installation is as it was, and you can try again or set up a new site.

themeSettings.contentWidthInvalid: Enter a valid CSS length, such as 64rem or 1100px.

themeSettings.faviconNone: No icon: the site uses the theme’s.

aiSettings.title: Generating pages with AI
aiSettings.intro: The provider that writes a page when someone asks for one, with this site's own key. The key is stored encrypted and never shown again.
aiSettings.loadError: The AI settings could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
aiSettings.serverDisabled: This server has nowhere safe to keep a key, so pages cannot be generated. Whoever installed Kometio can turn it on: see "Generating pages with AI" in the self-hosting guide.
aiSettings.baseUrlHint: OpenAI itself, or any server that speaks its API. The address it answers on, ending in /v1: https://api.openai.com/v1, or http://localhost:11434/v1 for a local server. A server on this machine or a private network also has to be allowed by whoever runs Kometio (KOMETIO_AI_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOSTS).
aiSettings.modelHintAnthropic: claude-opus-5 writes the best pages; claude-sonnet-5 is faster and costs less.
aiSettings.modelHintOpenAiCompatible: The model's name as that server knows it, such as gpt-5 or qwen3:14b. It has to support structured output (JSON schema).
aiSettings.apiKeyStored: A key ending in {{hint}} is saved. Leave this empty to keep it.
aiSettings.apiKeyStoredShort: A key is saved. Leave this empty to keep it.
aiSettings.apiKeyForNewServer: A different provider or server needs its key here: a saved key is only ever sent to the server it was entered for.
aiSettings.apiKeyRequired: Required for Claude. Create one in the Anthropic Console.
aiSettings.apiKeyOptional: Leave empty if the server does not ask for one.

aiSettings.removeConfirmBody: The provider and its key are forgotten, and nobody on this site can generate pages until they are set again. Pages already generated stay as they are.

failures.unreachable: The provider could not be reached. Check the server address in Integrations, or try again.

siteArchive.description: The whole site in one file, to open in another Kometio installation: from your computer to a server, from one server to another, or kept as a backup.

includes.title: What is in the file
includes.content: The pages and their history, forms, categories, and the site’s settings.
includes.accounts: The accounts, with their password hashes.

excludes.title: What is left out
excludes.sessions: Who is signed in, and the links still waiting: password resets, invitations, address confirmations.
excludes.submissions: The answers people sent through your forms.
excludes.aiKey: The AI provider’s key, which only the server it was entered on can read: enter it again in the new installation.

secret.title: Keep the file the way you keep a password
secret.body: It holds the password hashes of every account and every page, draft and form. Store it where only you can read it, and delete it when you no longer need it.

siteArchive.downloadHint: The download starts at once and is whole when your browser says it is done: a large site takes a little while. If it fails, try again in a minute; only one export runs at a time.

open.title: Open it in another installation
open.body: In a new installation, choose “I already have a site from another installation” on its first-run screen and give it this file. Or, on a server that has never been used, with the container stopped, run this command with the address it will be reached at (see “Move a site to another installation” in the image’s README):
open.command: docker run --rm -i -v kometio-data:/data -e DOMAIN=example.com ghcr.io/kometio/kometio:0.1.0-beta.1 import < kometio-site.tar.gz
open.after: Either way there is no account to create: the site is there, and you sign in with the account you had.
